construction: every 5.0 s of wall clock per (run, model): running set = requests with first_token_ts <= t < first_token_ts + decode_ms; generated-so-far interpolated linearly over the measured decode time (L >= 2 only); snapshots with < 5 running skipped. current_run_q65/q75/q85 replay the current rule with the reserve fitted on that run's own finished requests (warm state at low / medium / high congestion); current uses reserve_used.
